headline.text: L2 wrapper blade hit *3 outages* for doubles overnight—final replacement at 04:34 cleared it. ML4 blooming recurred twice; purging depositor 1 helped both times.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 3 ran FD Pecan Cluster after a 3:50am changeover, back up by 05:05. Sollich 1 stopped at 04:00 for pretzel cleanout after chocolate buffer ran dry. Sollich 4 had a chiller PSI issue at 08:01 requiring a pipe wash.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 hit doubles three times overnight (blade shimming twice, replacement once)—all cleared by 04:34. ML3 tossed 2 creme batches for viscosity, handled jams and doubles throughout the day, all resolved except possible top leaks flagged at 16:01.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 started with wrong recipe (old vs. new Milk Plain), corrected and depositing by 06:07. ML4 saw blooming on north-side bars twice—purging depositor 1 and clearing buildup resolved both. Truffle Line cleared 30-bin backup from shifted Cavanna belt by 14:23.

resolved.title: Sollich 4 chiller not working, PSI problem
resolved.summary: Chiller malfunction and PSI issue required washing the pipe to restore flow and resume cooking.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:01 — "The caramel got sent to the conbar at 8am" after pipe wash (S4 Kitchen Tablet).

resolved.title: Sollich 3 paused for chocolate buffer & melting tank
resolved.summary: Buffer tank nearly empty, melting tank chocolate too cold to turn on stirrer; paused line to catch up on chocolate supply.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:55 — "Production resumed at 3:55pm" (William Beattie).

resolved.title: ML3 stuck pieces from loose chain
resolved.summary: Many stuck pieces coming out at 18:44; maintenance found chain was loose, adjusted it.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 19:16 — "The chain was loose it's cutting now" (Fernando Flores).

resolved.title: ML3 creme viscosity too high, 2 batches tossed
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 20:30 waiting for QA; two batches failed viscosity (86k and 70k), were scrapped; new batch passed and line resumed.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 20:48 — "Line running again" after new batch passed QA (Molding Line 3 Filler).

resolved.title: ML2 wrapper doubles—blade shimming (1st outage)
resolved.summary: Line down at 23:27 for double wraps; maintenance shimmed blades, line back up at 00:04.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 00:04 — "Start line" (ML2 FW).

resolved.title: ML2 wrapper doubles—blade shimming (2nd outage)
resolved.summary: Line down again at 00:18 for continued doubles; maintenance shimmed blades again, line up at 01:11.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 01:11 — "Start line" (ML2 FW).

resolved.title: ML2 wrapper doubles—blade replacement (3rd outage)
resolved.summary: Line down at 03:30 for doubles again; maintenance took blade to shop, replaced it, line up at 04:34.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 04:34 — "Line is up. Maintenance took one of the blades to the shop and replaced it" (Gustavo Rodas).

resolved.title: ML3 mold jam in cooler
resolved.summary: Mold jumped a tooth causing jam in cooler at 09:52; mold repositioned correctly.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 09:53 — "Mold jam cleared, mold was positioned correctly. Line is back up" (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: ML3 doubles/triples from forming plate
resolved.summary: Line down at 12:40 for doubles and triples; team performed CIL on forming plate and vacuum.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 12:54 — "Line is back up. No more doubles or triples. Did a CIL on the forming plate and vacuum" (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: ML3 FW touchscreen frozen
resolved.summary: Flow wrapper touchscreen not responding to touch at 14:59; maintenance replaced screen, rebooted system.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:21 — "Line is running" after screen reset and film breaks cleared (Zack Kurtz).

resolved.title: ML2 accumulation belt trim by maintenance
resolved.summary: Long accumulation belt needed trimming; line down at 15:11, maintenance trimmed belt and team performed CIL.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:29 — "Line is back up. Maintenance trimmed belt and team performed CIL" (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: ML3 doubles/triples on pack
resolved.summary: Many doubles and triples coming through at 18:44; maintenance adjusted PG330.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 19:21 — "Made adjustments to pg330" (Fernando Flores).

resolved.title: ML2 right bobine not securing rolls
resolved.summary: Right bobine failed to secure wrapper rolls properly; maintenance addressed immediately.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:46 — "Lance already fixed it" (ML2 FW).

resolved.title: ML4 temper unit 2 no flow at shift start
resolved.summary: Temper unit 2 had no flow at 04:51; troubleshot, performed reheat, got flow throughout unit.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:21 — "We got a flow throughout temper unit 2, waiting on temper" (Kimberly Morales).

resolved.title: ML4 sweco north overfilled (1st time)
resolved.summary: North sweco overfilled at 01:57, thought to be creme residue from scraper return; Tyson cleaned screen, working fine.
resolved.resolution: Cleared same minute — "it is working fine now" after screen cleaning (Phillip Perez).

resolved.title: ML4 blooming on north-side bars (1st occurrence)
resolved.summary: Blooming observed on north-side bars at 01:44; stopped after Tyson emptied depositor 1 hopper, no more blooming by 01:36.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 01:36 — "No more signs of blooming. Good call on emptying on Depositor 1 Kimberly" (Tyson Fausett).

resolved.title: ML4 sweco north overfilled (2nd time)
resolved.summary: North sweco overfilled again at 03:29; removed screen to wash creme residue and scraper bin.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 04:20 — catch bin and screen passed level 1 cleaning per Jordan (Jordan Serna).

resolved.title: ML1 wrong temper recipe selected initially
resolved.summary: Operator selected old 'Milk Plain' recipe instead of 'Milk Plain New' at startup; temper results were off (slope 0.8-1.0).
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:40 — "We have changed it and will continue tempering and start when we have good results" (Imperial); depositing at 06:47.

resolved.title: ML1 received hopper on dep 1 overheating & empty
resolved.summary: Hopper received in overheating state and empty at shift start; team waited on temps to drop before filling.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:47 — "The line started at 6:47am" after temps dropped and hopper filled (Itzel Chavez).

resolved.title: Truffle Line Cavanna 2 exit belt shifted
resolved.summary: Exit belt on Cavanna 2 shifted at 14:02 causing 22-bin accumulation; maintenance adjusted belt, line running well by 14:23.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 14:23 — "The line is running well now; maintenance adjusted the belt" (TruffleLine FW).

resolved.title: Truffle Line paused 20 min to clear bin accumulation
resolved.summary: Stopped depositing at 14:10 with 30 bins accumulated from earlier Cavanna belt issue; gave 2nd shift time to clear bins.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:10 — "We are done with accumulation!" (Bojana McLeod).

resolved.title: ML4 blooming on north-side bars (2nd occurrence)
resolved.summary: Blooming reappeared at 14:57 on 2 bars per mold, north side; Shane found lot of buildup in dep 1 hopper and circuit 1 briefly spiked to 107°F.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 15:57 — "I have Preston and marcos here and all bars are good" after purging depositor and clearing buildup (Shane Olsen).

needs_attention.title: Sollich 1 stopped for pretzel cleanout, buffer empty
needs_attention.summary: Stopped loading chocolate at 04:00 when buffer hit 21%, line stopped ~15 min later to empty pretzels from system.
needs_attention.status: Both buffers at 0%, emptying pretzels from line as of 06:37 (Joseph Scott).

needs_attention.title: ML3 pieces coming with leaks in top
needs_attention.summary: Hervin flagged pieces with leaks in the top at 16:00; Alex acknowledged and said he'd check.
needs_attention.status: Alex going to look at 16:01 (Alex Mendoza).

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line skirts/feet on some truffles
needs_attention.summary: Kathleen flagged skirts, feet, and tails on truffles in photo at 14:15; production making adjustments, Jenny reported pair of skirts in each row at 14:32.
needs_attention.status: Production making adjustments as of 14:32; Jenny reported "pair of skirts in each row" (Jenny Medina).
